bootstrap.heading: First-time setup
bootstrap.tokenHelp: One-time token printed to the daemon log at first boot.

rules.tagline: Edit rules · define test fixtures below · Dry-run must pass before Apply.
rules.dryRunPassed_one: Dry-run passed ({{count}} fixture) — Apply is enabled.
rules.dryRunPassed_other: Dry-run passed ({{count}} fixtures) — Apply is enabled.
rules.addFixtureHint: Add at least one fixture below (domain + expected exit), then run Dry-run.
rules.runDryRunHint: Run Dry-run before Apply to guard against regressions.
rules.andMoreSeeTable: … and {{count}} more (see the results table below)
rules.noRulesYet: No rules yet. Click + Add rule above.
rules.noCustomExits: No custom exits configured yet. Add one on the <exitsLink>Exits</exitsLink> page.
rules.dryRunFixturesHelp: Each row asserts: given this domain, the ruleset must route it to the expected exit. Empty = only syntax + render check.
rules.noFixtures: No fixtures. Dry-run will still validate syntax; add fixtures if you want to assert specific routing decisions.
rules.importDescription: Fetch a Clash/mihomo-style rule list (one KIND,VALUE,POLICY line per rule) from a URL, or paste one below. All non-direct/block policies are rewritten to the action you choose so imported rules point at a real exit. Nothing is applied — the imported rules land as draft entries you can dry-run and Apply.
rules.importUrlHelp: Community-common sources (not endorsed, not preloaded): Loyalsoldier/clash-rules, ACL4SSR, MetaCubeX/meta-rules-dat. Verify the source before importing.

exits.title: Exits
exits.subtitle: Add a proxy by pasting its share URI · ss / vmess / trojan / vless / hysteria2 / tuic / anytls / socks5 / http(s).

snapshots.heading: Snapshots
snapshots.subheading: Every apply writes an immutable snapshot · rollback restores the paired rule_version as active.
snapshots.emptyState: No snapshots yet — apply a ruleset from the Rules page to generate one.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.subheading: Export a tar.gz of the active rule set plus snapshot metadata · import applies the bundle to the data plane after dry-run and health checks.
backup.exportDescription: Contains rules/active.yaml, snapshots/manifest.json, and a README.
backup.importDescription: Uploads apply the bundled rules immediately. A confirmation dialog previews the change before anything runs.
backup.confirmDialogDescription: Import will apply this rule set to the data plane immediately (via dry-run / health checks, automatic rollback on failure).

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Live tail via SSE · journalctl piped from the daemon host.
logs.errorNotSignedIn: not signed in — reload the page and log back in
logs.errorConnectionClosed: connection closed (auth rejected or server dropped)

settings.subtitle: System upgrade, Telegram notifications, iOS profile, account password.
settings.upgradeDescription: Check and apply the latest version. The service will restart during the upgrade and the page will briefly disconnect.
settings.upgradeInProgress: Upgrading, service will restart. Please wait…
settings.upgradeSubmittedRefresh: Upgrade request submitted. Refresh the page manually to confirm the version.
settings.upgradeTimeout: Service did not recover within 60 seconds. Please check the backend status manually.
settings.tgbotDescription: Telegram notification bot. Changes take effect immediately without restarting the process.
settings.botTokenHelp: Get it from BotFather. Leave empty to disable the bot.
settings.adminChatIdsHelpPrefix: Separate with spaces or commas. Send
settings.adminChatIdsHelpSuffix: to the bot to get your own chat_id.
settings.adminRequired: At least one admin chat id is required
settings.iosDescription: Scan the QR code or copy the link and open it in Safari to install the profile.
settings.iosNoProfile: The backend did not return a profile link. Please enter it manually or use the system QR scanner.
settings.changePasswordDescription: After a successful change the current session will be cleared and you must sign in again.
settings.newPasswordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
settings.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match
settings.newPasswordSameAsCurrent: New password must be different from the current one

wizard.heading: First-time setup
wizard.subheading: Let's get your panel configured. You can change any of this later in Settings.
wizard.serverDomainHelp: The hostname the panel serves under. Used by the TLS certificate and the iOS profile.
wizard.serverPanelBindHelp: 0.0.0.0 accepts external traffic · 127.0.0.1 restricts to SSH tunnel
wizard.serverPanelPortHelp: 443 = default HTTPS. 8443 = current default if you cannot free port 443.
wizard.tlsEnableLabel: Enable automatic TLS via Let's Encrypt
wizard.tlsEnableHelp: Requires port 80 free on this host. The daemon requests + auto-renews the certificate.
wizard.tlsEmailHelp: Sent to the CA as your ACME account owner — used for expiry reminders.
wizard.tgbotIntro: Optional — set up a Telegram bot to get panel notifications and run /status /exits without logging in.
wizard.tgbotTokenHelp: From @BotFather. Leave empty to disable the bot for now.
wizard.tgbotAdminIdsHelp: Comma or space separated numeric IDs. Send /id to the bot to get yours.
wizard.tgbotRequireIds: Provide at least one admin chat ID when a token is set.
wizard.reviewIntro: Review your choices. Nothing is written until you click Finish.
wizard.reviewTlsOff: disabled — using existing config.yaml TLS if set, plain HTTP otherwise
wizard.restartHint: Bind / port changes require a daemon restart to take effect. Use Settings → Restart daemon after finishing.
